findings.title: Missing label units are unconditionally accepted without a common coordinate basis
findings.ruling: F6 explicitly permits the overlay because association is independent of units. Association alone cannot supply the absent image-to-label unit/basis mapping. S3 always calls the composed result physical, while S5 has no common-unit or calibration-applicability gate. A numerical bbox comparison is not meaningful across an unknown unit/basis. Under the brief, that overlay needs an explicit compatibility contract or must be withheld.
findings.source_context: 0.4 §3.1 unit SHOULD; §3.4 distinguishes physical pixel size from per-pyramid relative downsampling when calibration is unavailable/applicable.
findings.diagnostic: alignment-diagnostic.json absent_unit_ambiguity and uncalibrated_relative_fallback; evaluator arithmetic only
findings.certainty: high; no runtime test needed to establish the missing contract and unconditional F6 expectation
findings.preservation: Same F6 expectation and same missing gate occur in initial lines 123/125/134; critic passes B2/B3 and final retains them. A1 corrected reader inheritance but did not repair the coordinate-basis dependency.

findings.title: F4b refusal expectation is not entailed by the stated bbox refusal predicate
findings.ruling: With equal array shapes and zero offsets, scales 0.5 and 1.0 yield overlapping bboxes. The only geometric rejection specified in S5 is disjointness. F4b nevertheless requires refusal/flagging, and supplies no threshold or additional predicate. The diagnostic proves only this contract mismatch; different scales by themselves are not a general alignment failure.
findings.certainty: high for written predicate mismatch; no claim about candidate renderer execution
findings.preservation: F4b is new after A1; final preserves the source correction but has not made its new prediction implementable.

findings.title: Contract extends to time/channel/custom-axis slicing despite strictly 2D brief
findings.ruling: The brief excludes time series and 3D, but S2 explicitly accepts an extra non-space time/channel/custom axis sliced at index 0 while still requiring transformation vectors of length 2. No singleton-only exception or projection contract is defined. This is an out-of-scope extension and a dimension-consistency ambiguity, not an NGFF prohibition.
findings.certainty: high for literal scope mismatch; no execution claim
findings.preservation: Initial S2 line122 already has this exception; critic B1 PASS and final line143 keep it.
